name: Waterfall.io
one_liner: Waterfall aggregates 30+ B2B data vendors into one API for contact, email, phone and company enrichment, search, verification and job-change checks.
auth_notes: API key in the x-api-key header; sub-keys managed with a master key. Webhook deliveries are Ed25519-signed with a JWKS endpoint.
access_notes: Keys are not self-serve: docs say to contact the team for API access and pricing. No public rate card; pricing is quoted after a benchmark on your data. No free trial stated.

buildability.rationale: Well-documented REST API with api key auth, but credentials require contacting the vendor and commercial quote; no self-serve signup or public pricing.

identity.quote: Waterfall® aggregates 30+ different data vendors so that you can maximize contact, email and mobile number coverage

auth.quote: Authenticate data and account API requests with your Waterfall API key in the x-api-key header.

access.quote: Contact the team for API access and pricing.
Why there is no public rate card

api_surface.quote: The default limit for Prospector, Search, Enrichment, Job Change, and Email Verification is 50 requests per 60 seconds.
For automated delivery, add awebhook_url to the launch request.

buildability.quote: Contact the team for access and pricing.

disputes.why: Vendor docs state to contact the team for API access and pricing; pricing page has no public rate card.
Credentials require vendor contact and quote, not self-serve.
Quickstart documents webhook_url and signed webhook verification.
